filter_structure_by_entity_type: filter a Structure to only include protein chains using filter_to_entity_type
stack_multiple_structures: stack multiple Structure objects into a single multi-model Structure using the stack function
concatenate_structures: concatenate multiple Structure objects along the atom dimension using the concat function
generate_bioassembly: generate a biological assembly from a Structure using generate_bioassembly with an assembly_id
export_structure_to_mmcif: export a Structure to an mmCIF string using the to_mmcif method
